title: Invoice email to a sheet row
summary: Details are extracted from an emailed invoice, the amounts are checked, and one row is added to your invoices table; incomplete or inconsistent invoices are held for review.

requirements.purpose: The invoices table that receives one row per invoice (unique on vendor and invoice number).

success_criteria: A complete invoice whose net plus tax equals its total adds one row with the invoice number, vendor, date, currency, net, tax and total exactly as written on the invoice.
An invoice with a missing field or amounts that do not add up adds no row and is held for review with the reason.
The same vendor and invoice number never adds a second row.

config.prompt: The upstream output is an email carrying an invoice (from, subject, body). Extract invoice_number, vendor, date (YYYY-MM-DD), currency (ISO code), net, tax and total as written; use null for anything not stated, never a guess. complete is true only when all seven are present. consistent is true only when net + tax equals total to the cent. Respond with {"complete": bool, "consistent": bool, "problem": null or one sentence, "invoice": {the seven fields}, "parameters": [invoice_number, vendor, date, currency, net, tax, total]}.

success_criteria: Every extracted value appears in the email; missing values are null, never guessed.
consistent reflects whether net plus tax equals total exactly.

arguments.statement: INSERT INTO invoices (invoice_number, vendor, invoice_date, currency, net, tax, total) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (vendor, invoice_number) DO NOTHING

config.prompt: The invoice in the upstream output was not added. Respond with {"status": "needs_review", "reason": one sentence naming the missing field or the amounts that do not add up}.

success_criteria: reason names the actual missing field or arithmetic mismatch.

test_cases.name: consistent invoice adds a row

input.subject: Invoice SP-1042
input.body:
Sharma Print Works
Invoice number: SP-1042
Date: 2026-09-28
Net: INR 12,000.00
GST 18%: INR 2,160.00
Total due: INR 14,160.00

success_criteria: One row is added with invoice number SP-1042, vendor Sharma Print Works, date 2026-09-28, currency INR, net 12000.00, tax 2160.00 and total 14160.00.
The invoice is not held for review.

test_cases.name: amounts that do not add up are held

input.subject: Invoice 77
input.body:
Northwind Supplies
Invoice 77
Date: 2026-09-30
Net: USD 500.00
Tax: USD 45.00
Total: USD 600.00

success_criteria: The invoice is held for review because 500.00 plus 45.00 does not equal 600.00.
